title: How to create Kubernetes Jobs from AWS Lambda
summary: A tutorial for a Lambda function (a Bash custom runtime that downloads `kubectl` on start) that runs kubectl commands against a cluster, used here to launch a Kubernetes Job in response to an event. It is written for Cloudfleet’s own managed Kubernetes and its CLI, so the authentication steps need changing for other clusters, and passing raw kubectl arguments in an event is fine for a demo but too permissive for production.
